key_difference: (D) adds a separate decodeForLocalFile() that UTF-8-decodes valid percent-encoded sequences and only rejects percent-decoded backslashes, whereas (B) extends decode() to reject every percent-decoded byte >= 0x80 and, on Windows, any literal backslash (because QUrl stores backslashes decoded); so (D) misses the stored-backslash case and accepts percent-encoded non-ASCII that (B) rejects.
